title: TopologyResultScope
description: Opaque, topology-service-owned handle for targeting the result of a relationship compile in a later follow-up. The handle must be pod-independent and resolvable through shared service state such as Redis plus durable session/artifact state.

scopeId.description: Opaque result scope id. Clients pass it back but do not interpret it.

kind.description: Kind of result captured by this scope.

relationshipId.description: Relationship id that produced this scope, when applicable.

catalogIds.description: Semantic catalog ids associated with the scoped result, when known.

qualifiers.description: Relationship qualifiers used to produce this scope.

graphElementKinds.description: Graph element kinds represented by the scoped result.

base.description: Base graph compatibility key used to validate later targetScope use.

sessionId.description: Visibility session id that owns this scope, when compiled for a workbench session.

artifactId.description: Artifact id that owns this scope, when compiled for an artifact document.

sessionRevision.description: Visibility session revision observed when this scope was produced.

overlayRevision.description: Artifact overlay revision observed when this scope was produced.

expiresAt.description: Optional expiry time for conservative client behavior. topology-service remains authoritative for TTL and compatibility validation.

diagnostics.description: Non-fatal diagnostics associated with this result scope.
